newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar upgraded to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Acindar upgraded to buy.

text.p: - Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said it was upgrading Argentine steelmaker Acindar to buy from hold and changed its net profit estimate for fiscal year 1997 to $27.8 million from $19.6 million.
- It added it was raising its profit estimate in fiscal 1998 to $32.5 million from $27.6 million.

- Q2 1997 results showed sales domestically increased 28 percent year over year. Sales were also 6.6 percent higher in Q2 from Q1 which is unusual since sales are usually slower in December due to Christmas and the coming summer season.
- On a 1997 P/E basis, the company trades at a 12 percent discount over the market and on a P/BV the company trades at a 36 percent discount.
- DMG's new target price for 1997 is $1.96. It now trades around $1.53.
